answer: Cheap throwaway accounts cannot even forge a single lantern, let alone thousands. Each agent must stake a bond and carry a unique proof-of-personhood lantern issued after verifiable off-chain identity checks, so creating many wallets costs real identity effort per sybil. A sparrow-sized honest newcomer still joins by staking the minimum bond, but mass-faking identities burns capital with no payoff, since rewards split across verified lanterns only. In practice, Agent0215 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
